mapper.sql: pr.id, pr.agent_id, pr.product_id, pr.transaction_amount, pr.profit_rate, pr.profit_amount, pr.merchant_id, pr.machine_id, pr.transaction_no, pr.status, pr.create_time, a.agent_name as agent_name, p.product_name as product_name, m.merchant_name as merchant_name, mac.machine_sn as machine_sn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM profit_records pr LEFT JOIN agents a ON pr.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON pr.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN machines mac ON pr.machine_id = mac.id WHERE pr.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM profit_records pr LEFT JOIN agents a ON pr.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON pr.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN machines mac ON pr.machine_id = mac.id WHERE pr.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY pr.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profit_records WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}

SELECT FROM profit_records pr LEFT JOIN agents a ON pr.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON pr.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN machines mac ON pr.machine_id = mac.id WHERE pr.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY pr.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profit_records (agent_id, product_id, transaction_amount, profit_rate, profit_amount, merchant_id, machine_id, transaction_no, status, create_time) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{productId}, #{transactionAmount}, #{profitRate}, #{profitAmount}, #{merchantId}, #{machineId}, #{transactionNo}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
